description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

 We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

 Role 

 
 We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to join our team. This is a Hybrid role for Santa Clara, CA, reporting to the Sr Manager, Software Development Engineering in the Engineering department. As an engineer on the Data & APIs team, you will build large-scale data pipelines and real-time streaming systems that process Zscaler's security telemetry at scale, along with the APIs that expose it to internal and external consumers. You will own features end-to-end across the streaming pipeline and API surface—writing production code, contributing to distributed-systems design, and operating what you build. 

 What you’ll do (Role Expectations) 

 
 Build and maintain backend services and APIs (REST/gRPC) that expose Zscaler's security data to internal teams and customers, writing production-quality code across the request path 

 Contribute to large-scale streaming and batch data pipelines (Kafka, Spark/Flink) and the storage layer (SQL, NoSQL, columnar) that feed those APIs — writing processing logic, tuning performance, and helping triangulate bottlenecks in production 

 Participate in design discussions, write and review design docs for features you own, and contribute to AI/ML enabled anomaly-detection and signal-correlation logic over streaming telemetry. 

 Instrument, monitor, and operate the services you build — including on-call rotation, incident response, and continuous improvement of reliability and performance 

 Spot pain points and friction in the existing system (bugs, slow queries, flaky tests, manual toil) and propose or ship improvements; partner with senior engineers, Product, and consuming teams to clarify requirements and deliver features — fluently using modern AI coding, review, and agentic tools across the SDLC 

 
 Who You Are (Success Profile) 

 
 You are an innovative problem-solver who is energized by complex technical challenges and actively seeks them out to find creative solutions. 

 You are a pragmatic builder who loves shipping high-quality code, rolling up your sleeves, and iterating quickly without sacrificing stability or standards. 

 You are a lifelong learner with a true growth mindset, actively seeking out feedback and continuously looking for ways to improve your skills. 

 You operate with a strong sense of urgency, focusing on high-impact delivery and understanding that speed and quality are both essential in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. 

 You are a high-trust collaborator who is ambitious for the team, communicates with directness and candor, and serves as a reliable partner to teammates across various functions. 

 
 What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications) 

 
 Demonstrated fluency with the AI-augmented SDLC — daily, hands-on use of modern AI coding assistants, code-review tools, and agentic workflows — with a proven history of integrating new AI technologies to enhance daily workflows and augment problem-solving 

 0-2 years of professional software engineering experience building backend services, with proficiency in at least one of Java, Python, or Go 

 Hands-on experience designing and building APIs (REST and/or gRPC), including schema definition, versioning, and auth 

 Working experience with streaming/batch data technologies (Kafka, Spark, Flink, Airflow, or equivalent) and relational and/or NoSQL databases, including basic performance analysis of pipelines (throughput, lag, resource utilization) 

 Exposure to Azure and/or GCP (compute, managed data services, networking) and containerized environments (Docker/Kubernetes), with basic observability and debugging skills 

 Strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, and distributed systems (consistency, partitioning, replication, fault tolerance, backpressure), with a clear track record of shipping production features end-to-end 

 
 What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications) 

 
 Proven ability to leverage AI technologies and workflows to drive measurable operational efficiency 

 Experience with anomaly detection, signal triangulation, or correlation techniques over large-scale telemetry, logs, or security/networking data — statistical, rules-based, or ML 

 Hands-on experience with Azure and/or GCP managed streaming and data services (Azure Event Hubs / Stream Analytics / Synapse / Cosmos DB; GCP Pub/Sub / Dataflow / BigQuery / Bigtable) and modern warehouse/lakehouse tech (Snowflake, Databricks, ClickHouse, Elasticsearch) 

 Experience with API-first development practices — OpenAPI/protobuf, contract testing, and API lifecycle management

 Zscaler’s salary ranges are benchmarked and are determined by role and level. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position across all US locations and could be higher or lower based on a multitude of factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

 The base salary range listed for this full-time position excludes commission/ bonus/ equity (if applicable) + benefits.

 Base Pay Range
 $101,500 — $145,000 USD 


 At Zscaler, we are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve and the customers we work with. We foster an inclusive environment that values all backgrounds and perspectives, emphasizing collaboration and belonging. Join us in our mission to make doing business seamless and secure.

 Our Benefits program is one of the most important ways we support our employees. Zscaler proudly offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families throughout their life stages, including:

 
 
 Various health plans

 Time off plans for vacation and sick time

 Parental leave options

 Retirement options

 Education reimbursement

 In-office perks, and more!
